nonBlockingObservations.observation: The counts 8,112 distinct (content, grammar) pairs and 7,988 distinct trees match RUN-a joined to pins/t2a-selected.tsv. Within one grammar, no content hash maps to two trees. Fourteen content hashes occur under two grammars and therefore have two trees, including the empty file (22 javascript files share one tree; one typescript file has another). The clause 'no content maps to two trees' is broader than the per-grammar fact. P3 is unchanged: all 8,351 wasm and native tree byte strings match.
